subject: Civil Engineering
title: Look-Ahead Schedules
description: A quick win: understand Look-Ahead Schedules.

hook.text: The master schedule spans years. But what exactly happens next week? That's the look-ahead.

buildup.text: A look-ahead schedule covers 2-6 weeks — detailed daily tasks with specific crews assigned.

discovery.text: It identifies constraints — missing materials, pending inspections, prerequisite work — before they block.

twist.text: The Last Planner System asks foremen to commit only to tasks they're certain they can complete.

climax.text: Tracking percent plan complete (PPC) measures reliability — high PPC means a predictable site.

punchline.text: The master schedule plans the dream. The look-ahead plans reality.

quiz.question: What does the Last Planner System ask foremen to do?
options: Complete tasks as fast as possible regardless of quality
Commit only to tasks they're certain they can complete, improving schedule reliability
Work overtime to catch up with the master schedule
